diagnostics.message: The VPC Flow Logs policy attachment is created independently of the per-region flow-log modules. Each flow-log resource uses the publisher role ARN, but may be created before its inline publish policy is attached, causing initial log delivery failures; add an ordering dependency or wire the policy attachment into the module setup.

The VPC baseline module's flow-log resource depends on the publisher role ARN but not on the policy attachment that grants CloudWatch Logs publishing permissions. Ensure the policy is attached before flow-log creation.
The VPC baseline's flow-log resource can be created before the shared publisher role's inline policy grants CloudWatch Logs permissions. Add ordering from this module to the publisher policy.
